name: diffier
description: IntelliJ-style Git diff editor for macOS
author: Alan Fitzgerald

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.highlighter.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: node test/git.test.js && node test/keymap.test.js && node test/themes.test.js && node test/languages.test.js
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:highlighter || node -e "console.warn('shiki highlighter bundle skipped; falling back to built-in grammars')"
